// v1.1: a single mesh with geometrically linked lips, cheek, smile folds and jaw.
// WebGL draws original identity texture with smooth viseme/muscle displacements.
const motion={started:false,last:0,nextBlink:0,eyeStart:-1,eye:0,lip:0,lipTarget:0,
 spread:0,spreadTarget:0, mouthTrack:[], speechBoundary:-1,boundaryAt:0,boundarySamples:0,
 speechRatePerChar:150,progress:0,progressTime:0, speechGeneration:0,

function compileShader(gl,type,src){const sh=gl.createShader(type);gl.shaderSource(sh,src);gl.compileShader(sh);if(!gl.getShaderParameter(sh,gl.COMPILE_STATUS))throw Error(gl.getShaderInfoLog(sh));return sh}
const faceVS=`precision highp float;
attribute vec2 aPos;
uniform float uJaw,uSmile,uRound,uSpread;
varying vec2 vUV;
float g(vec2 p,vec2 c,vec2 r){vec2 d=(p-c)/r;return exp(-2.1*dot(d,d));}
float smoothRamp(float a,float b,float v){float t=clamp((v-a)/(b-a),0.,1.);return t*t*(3.-2.*t);}
void main(){
 vec2 p=aPos;
 // Mouth region only. Philtrum / nose remain absolutely fixed above 539px.
 float jawGate=smoothRamp(548.,577.,p.y);
 float lipGate=smoothRamp(542.,552.,p.y);
 float cornerL=g(p,vec2(342.,552.),vec2(39.,28.));
 float cornerR=g(p,vec2(426.,546.),vec2(39.,28.));
 // Mouth corners barely pull laterally and up; nostrils are never affected.
 vec2 move=vec2((-2.2*cornerL+2.2*cornerR)*uSmile*lipGate,
  (-1.9*cornerL-1.9*cornerR)*uSmile*lipGate);
 // Jaw opens by lower lip & small chin movement. Anchored at upper lip.
 move.y+=uJaw*jawGate*(4.2*g(p,vec2(384.,581.),vec2(77.,35.))
                  +2.0*g(p,vec2(383.,617.),vec2(83.,50.)));
 // Different Japanese vowel silhouettes: sideways i/e, rounded u/o.
 // No displacement at all in the philtrum or nasal region.
 move.x+=(uRound*(2.2*cornerL-2.2*cornerR)
          +uSpread*(-2.4*cornerL+2.4*cornerR))*lipGate;
 // Slight cheek raise below nose, not a full-face distortion
 float cheek= g(p,vec2(317.,565.),vec2(55.,35.)) + g(p,vec2(459.,559.),vec2(55.,35.));
 move.y-=uSmile*0.55*lipGate*cheek;
 // Fade every displacement out before mouth region ends
 float local=smoothRamp(290.,315.,p.x)*(1.-smoothRamp(477.,517.,p.x));
 move*=local;
 vec2 q=p+move;
 gl_Position=vec4(q.x/646.*2.-1.,1.-q.y/1414.*2.,0.,1.);
 vUV=vec2(p.x/646.,1.-p.y/1414.);
}`;
const faceFS=`precision highp float;
varying vec2 vUV;
uniform sampler2D uBase,uTalk,uClosed;
uniform float uJaw,uEye,uSmile,uRound;
float g(vec2 p,vec2 c,vec2 r){vec2 d=(p-c)/r;return exp(-2.0*dot(d,d));}
float smoothRamp(float a,float b,float v){float t=clamp((v-a)/(b-a),0.,1.);return t*t*(3.-2.*t);}
void main(){
 vec2 p=vec2(vUV.x*646.,(1.-vUV.y)*1414.);
 vec4 color=texture2D(uBase,vUV);
 // Blend only the lip opening itself, never philtrum, nostrils or cheeks.
 float lipMask=g(p,vec2(385.,559.),vec2(73.,25.)) * smoothRamp(543.,552.,p.y);
 float lipBlend=clamp((uJaw*.96+uRound*.10)*lipMask,0.,.96);
 color=mix(color,texture2D(uTalk,vUV),lipBlend);
 // Very shallow inner-mouth cavity revealed by lowering the jaw, tapered at corners.
 float cross=clamp((p.x-381.)/49.,-1.,1.);
 float aperture=sqrt(max(0.,1.-cross*cross));
 float seam=557.-0.17*(p.x-380.)+1.2*cross*cross;
 float gap=5.6*uJaw*aperture;
 float top=smoothRamp(seam-1.0,seam+1.0,p.y);
 float bottom=1.-smoothRamp(seam+gap-0.6,seam+gap+1.2,p.y);
 float cavity=top*bottom*aperture*clamp(uJaw*1.4,0.,1.);
 color.rgb=mix(color.rgb,vec3(.24,.085,.115),cavity*.74);
 float e1=g(p,vec2(247.,432.),vec2(80.,43.));
 float e2=g(p,vec2(420.,395.),vec2(78.,43.));
 float eyeMask=clamp(max(e1,e2)*1.42,0.,1.);
 color=mix(color,texture2D(uClosed,vUV),uEye*eyeMask);
 gl_FragColor=color;
}`;
function getFaceMesh(){const xs=[0];for(let i=16;i<646;i+=16)xs.push(i);xs.push(646);
 const ys=[0];for(let i=18;i<1414;i+=18)ys.push(i);ys.push(1414);
 const v=[];for(let y=0;y<ys.length-1;y++)for(let x=0;x<xs.length-1;x++){
 const a=xs[x],b=xs[x+1],c=ys[y],d=ys[y+1];v.push(a,c,b,c,a,d,b,c,b,d,a,d);
 }return new Float32Array(v)}
async function initFaceRig(){
 let gl;try{gl=faceCanvas.getContext('webgl',{alpha:true,antialias:true,preserveDrawingBuffer:true,premultipliedAlpha:false});
 if(!gl)throw Error('WebGL unavailable');
 const prog=gl.createProgram();gl.attachShader(prog,compileShader(gl,gl.VERTEX_SHADER,faceVS));gl.attachShader(prog,compileShader(gl,gl.FRAGMENT_SHADER,faceFS));gl.linkProgram(prog);
 if(!gl.getProgramParameter(prog,gl.LINK_STATUS))throw Error(gl.getProgramInfoLog(prog));
 gl.useProgram(prog);faceGL=gl;faceProgram=prog;
 const buffer=gl.createBuffer();faceBuffer=buffer;gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER,buffer);
 const mesh=getFaceMesh();gl.bufferData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER,mesh,gl.STATIC_DRAW);faceCanvas.dataset.vertices=mesh.length/2;
 const loc=gl.getAttribLocation(prog,'aPos');gl.enableVertexAttribArray(loc);gl.vertexAttribPointer(loc,2,gl.FLOAT,false,0,0);
 faceUniforms={};for(let name of ['uJaw','uEye','uSmile','uRound','uSpread'])faceUniforms[name]=gl.getUniformLocation(prog,name);
 const files=['base','mouth','blink'];const images=await Promise.all(files.map(n=>new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{
 const i=new Image();i.onload=()=>resolve(i);i.onerror=()=>reject(Error('texture load: '+n));i.src=SERENA_EMBEDDED_ASSETS[n];}))); 
 gl.pixelStorei(gl.UNPACK_FLIP_Y_WEBGL,true);
 images.forEach((img,idx)=>{const tex=gl.createTexture();faceTextures[idx]=tex;gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE0+idx);gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D,tex);
 gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D,gl.TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER,gl.LINEAR);gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D,gl.TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER,gl.LINEAR);
 gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D,gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_S,gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE);gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D,gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_T,gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
 gl.texImage2D(gl.TEXTURE_2D,0,gl.RGBA,gl.RGBA,gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE,img);
 gl.uniform1i(gl.getUniformLocation(prog,['uBase','uTalk','uClosed'][idx]),idx)});
 gl.viewport(0,0,646,1414);gl.clearColor(0,0,0,0);motion.rendererReady=true;renderFace();
 }catch(e){console.warn('GPU expression fallback',e.message);motion.rendererReady=false;faceCanvas.style.display='none';
 $('#faceIdle').style.display='block';await initFaceFallback();}
}
async function initFaceFallback(){
 // Precomputed geometric deformations instead of overlaying a blinking mouth picture.
 try{face2D=faceCanvas.getContext('2d',{alpha:true});
 if(!face2D)throw Error('Canvas2D unavailable');
 const load=n=>new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const img=new Image();img.onload=()=>resolve(img);img.onerror=()=>reject(Error('Load '+n));img.src=SERENA_EMBEDDED_ASSETS[n]});
 [faceAtlas,eyeAtlas]=await Promise.all([load('muscles_vowels'),load('blink_atlas')]);
 faceCanvas.style.display='block';motion.fallbackReady=true;renderFace();
 }catch(err){console.warn('2D muscle animation fallback unavailable',err.message);faceCanvas.style.display='none'}
}
function drawFallbackCell(index,smileIndex,viseme,weight){if(weight<.008)return;
 const w=291,h=228;
 face2D.globalAlpha=weight;
 face2D.drawImage(faceAtlas,index*w,(viseme*3+smileIndex)*h,w,h,235,455,w,h);
}
function drawFallback(){if(!face2D||!motion.fallbackReady)return;
 face2D.clearRect(0,0,646,1414);
 const jaw=bound(motion.lip/.86,0,1)*10,smile=bound(motion.smile,0,.9)/.45;
 const j=Math.min(9,Math.floor(jaw)),jf=jaw-j;
 const a=Math.min(1,Math.floor(smile)),af=smile-a;
 // Each pose blends jaw, cheeks, rounded lips and lip spreading.
 let spread=bound(motion.spread,0,1),round=bound(motion.round,0,1);
 const denom=Math.max(1,spread+round);spread/=denom;round/=denom;
 const forms=[[0,Math.max(0,1-spread-round)],[1,spread],[2,round]];
 for(const [v,vw] of forms){if(vw<.01)continue;
  drawFallbackCell(j,a,v,(1-jf)*(1-af)*vw);
  drawFallbackCell(j+1,a,v,jf*(1-af)*vw);
  drawFallbackCell(j,a+1,v,(1-jf)*af*vw);
  drawFallbackCell(j+1,a+1,v,jf*af*vw);
 }
 face2D.globalAlpha=1;
 if(eyeAtlas&&motion.eye>.002){const t=motion.eye*12,l=Math.floor(t),r=Math.min(12,l+1),f=t-l,w=369,h=220;
 const draw=(idx,weight)=>{if(weight<.005)return;face2D.globalAlpha=weight;
 face2D.drawImage(eyeAtlas,idx%7*w,Math.floor(idx/7)*h,w,h,153,310,w,h)};
 draw(l,1-f);draw(r,f);face2D.globalAlpha=1;}
}
function renderFace(){if(!faceGL||!motion.rendererReady){drawFallback();return;}
 const gl=faceGL;gl.useProgram(faceProgram);gl.clear(gl.COLOR_BUFFER_BIT);
 for(const [name,val] of Object.entries({uJaw:motion.lip,uEye:motion.eye,uSmile:motion.smile,uRound:motion.round,uSpread:motion.spread}))gl.uniform1f(faceUniforms[name],val);
 gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLES,0,Number(faceCanvas.dataset.vertices));
}
// v1.1. Approximate articulatory timing from characters and any speech-boundary events.
// Browser TTS does NOT expose actual phonemes/audio amplitude; this is explicitly an estimate.
function mouthForCharacter(c){
 if(/[\s、。！？!?….,，．　]/.test(c))return {jaw:0,spread:0,round:0,pause:true};
 if(/[ぁあかがさざただなはばぱまやゃらわァアカガサザタダナハバパマヤャラワ]/.test(c))return {jaw:.83,spread:.10,round:0};
 if(/[ぃいきぎしじちぢにひびぴみりゐィイキギシジチヂニヒビピミリ]/.test(c))return {jaw:.27,spread:.87,round:0};
 if(/[ぅうくぐすずつづぬふぶぷむゆゅるヴゥウクグスズツヅヌフブプムユュル]/.test(c))return {jaw:.23,spread:0,round:.90};
 if(/[ぇえけげせぜてでねへべぺめれゑェエケゲセゼテデネヘベペメレ]/.test(c))return {jaw:.62,spread:.48,round:0};
 if(/[ぉおこごそぞとどのほぼぽもよょろをォオコゴソゾトドノホボポモヨョロヲ]/.test(c))return {jaw:.64,spread:0,round:.72};
 if(/[んンっッ]/.test(c))return {jaw:.055,spread:0,round:0};
 // Kanji and English are only loosely estimated; don't imply exact lip sync.
 return {jaw:.36,spread:.21,round:.10};
}
function mouthTrackFor(text){return Array.from(String(text).slice(0,1100)).map(mouthForCharacter)}
function startMouthTrack(s,now=performance.now()){
 motion.speechStart=now;motion.progress=0;motion.speechBoundary=-1;
 motion.boundaryAt=now;motion.boundarySamples=0;motion.speechRatePerChar=150;
 motion.mouthTrack=mouthTrackFor(s);motion.syllables=[];motion.progressTime=now;
}
function mouthBoundary(index,now=performance.now()){
 if(!speechActive||!Number.isFinite(index)||index<0)return;
 const n=motion.mouthTrack.length;
 if(n===0)return;
 const safe=Math.min(n-1,Math.floor(index));
 if(motion.speechBoundary>=0 && safe>motion.speechBoundary){
  const observed=(now-motion.boundaryAt)/(safe-motion.speechBoundary);
  if(observed>35&&observed<400){motion.speechRatePerChar=motion.speechRatePerChar*.65+observed*.35}
 }
 if(safe>=motion.speechBoundary){
  motion.speechBoundary=safe;motion.boundaryAt=now;motion.boundarySamples++;
  // Align to the renderer's actual reported text index without restarting the timeline.
  motion.progress=Math.max(motion.progress,safe);
 }
}
function mouthStateAt(now){
 if(!speechActive||!motion.mouthTrack.length)return {jaw:0,spread:0,round:0};
 const n=motion.mouthTrack.length;
 // Let boundary notifications calibrate character speed; fall back to a monotonic clock.
 let estimate;
 if(motion.speechBoundary>=0){
  const since=Math.max(0,now-motion.boundaryAt);
  estimate=motion.speechBoundary + since/motion.speechRatePerChar;
 }else{
  estimate=Math.max(0,now-motion.speechStart)/motion.speechRatePerChar;
 }
 // Never jump backward when boundaries arrive late.
 const maxAdvance=Math.max(.04,(now-motion.progressTime)/Math.max(90,motion.speechRatePerChar)*1.35);
 motion.progress=Math.max(motion.progress,Math.min(estimate,motion.progress+maxAdvance));
 motion.progressTime=now;
 const idx=Math.min(n-1,Math.floor(motion.progress));
 const t=bound(motion.progress-idx,0,1),v=motion.mouthTrack[idx];
 const next=motion.mouthTrack[Math.min(idx+1,n-1)];
 // Smooth onset and offset, with real pauses for punctuation.
 const blend=softEase(t);
 const m={jaw:v.jaw*(1-blend)+next.jaw*blend,spread:v.spread*(1-blend)+next.spread*blend,round:v.round*(1-blend)+next.round*blend};
 // Closure at mora edges and stops, without regular sine-wave mechanical chattering.
 const articulation=.76+.24*Math.sin(Math.PI*bound(t,0,1));
 return {jaw:bound(m.jaw*articulation,0,.86),spread:bound(m.spread*articulation,0,1),round:bound(m.round*articulation,0,1)};
}
function motionLoop(now){if(!motion.started)return;requestAnimationFrame(motionLoop);
 if(document.hidden||matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches){motion.eye=0;motion.lip=0;motion.last=now;return}
 const dt=bound((now-(motion.last||now))/1000,.001,.05);motion.last=now;
 if(now>=motion.nextBlink&&motion.eyeStart<0){motion.eyeStart=now;motion.nextBlink=now+3100+Math.random()*3700}
 if(motion.eyeStart>=0){const t=now-motion.eyeStart,c=110,h=45,o=155;
 motion.eye=t<c?softEase(t/c):t<c+h?1:t<c+h+o?1-softEase((t-c-h)/o):0;
 if(t>=c+h+o)motion.eyeStart=-1}else motion.eye=0;
 const mouth=mouthStateAt(now);
 motion.lipTarget=mouth.jaw;motion.spreadTarget=mouth.spread;motion.roundTarget=mouth.round;
 motion.lip+=(motion.lipTarget-motion.lip)*(1-Math.exp(-dt*10));
 const mood=$('#actor').classList;
 motion.smileTarget=mood.contains('smile')?.72:mood.contains('kind')?.52:mood.contains('serious')?.10:.28;
 motion.smile+=(motion.smileTarget-motion.smile)*(1-Math.exp(-dt*3.4));
 motion.round+=(motion.roundTarget-motion.round)*(1-Math.exp(-dt*10));
 motion.spread+=(motion.spreadTarget-motion.spread)*(1-Math.exp(-dt*11));
 const nodElapsed=now-motion.nodAt,nodVal=nodElapsed>0&&nodElapsed<850?Math.pow(Math.sin(Math.PI*nodElapsed/850),2):0;
 const t=now/1000+motion.phase,breathe=Math.sin(t*Math.PI*2/5.6),drift=Math.sin(t*.53)*.7+Math.sin(t*.21)*.25;
 const x=.9*drift,y=-1.2*breathe+1.1*nodVal,tilt=.36*Math.sin(t*.39)+.12*Math.sin(t*.17)+.6*nodVal;
 $('#actor').style.transform=`translate3d(${x.toFixed(2)}px,${y.toFixed(2)}px,0) rotate(${tilt.toFixed(2)}deg) scale(${(1+breathe*.0014).toFixed(5)})`;
 if(now-motion.lastDraw>=30||motion.lastDraw===0){renderFace();motion.lastDraw=now}
}
function beginMotion(){if(motion.started)return;motion.started=true;initFaceRig();motion.last=0;motion.nextBlink=performance.now()+1200+Math.random()*1400;requestAnimationFrame(motionLoop)}
function nod(){motion.nodAt=performance.now()}
function blink(){if(motion.eyeStart<0)motion.eyeStart=performance.now()}
function loopBlink(){beginMotion()}

function renderStage(){let last=messages[messages.length-1];if(last&&last.role==='assistant')$('#subtitle').textContent=last.content;else $('#subtitle').textContent='おかえりなさい　今日は何から始めましょうか';}
function addMessage(role,content){const m={role,content:txt(content,3500)};messages.push(m);messages=messages.slice(-24);save();renderChat();renderStage();if(role==='assistant'){setMood(moodFrom(m.content));nod()}return m}
function renderChat(){const area=$('#chatLog');area.innerHTML=messages.length?messages.map(m=>'<div class="bubble '+m.role+'">'+esc(m.content)+'</div>').join(''):'<div class="empty">まだ会話はありません</div>';area.scrollTop=area.scrollHeight}
function todayEvents(){return data.events.filter(e=>e.date===dateKey()).sort((a,b)=>String(a.time).localeCompare(String(b.time)))}
function openTasks(){return data.tasks.filter(x=>!x.done)}
function offlineReply(text){const q=txt(text,450);if(/今日.*(予定|スケジュール)|予定.*今日|本日.*予定/.test(q)){const es=todayEvents();return es.length?'今日の予定は '+es.map(e=>e.time+' '+e.name).join('、')+' です':'今日の登録予定はありません'}if(/(未完了|残り|今日).*(タスク|仕事)|タスク|やること/.test(q)){const ts=openTasks();return ts.length?'未完了タスクは'+ts.length+'件です '+ts.slice(0,5).map(t=>t.name).join('、')+' です':'未完了タスクはありません'}if(/何ができる|機能|使い方/.test(q))return '予定とタスクを管理できます 自由な相談や会話には設定からAI接続を有効にしてください';if(/こんにちは|おはよう|こんばんは|お疲れ/.test(q))return 'お疲れさまです 今日は何をお手伝いしましょうか';if(/ありがとう/.test(q))return 'どういたしまして いつでも声をかけてください';return '今はAI未接続のローカルモードです 自由な会話には設定からAI接続先を登録してください 予定やタスクの確認は今すぐできます'}
function aiContext(){return {date:dateKey(),events:todayEvents().slice(0,16).map(e=>({date:e.date,time:e.time,name:txt(e.name,120)})),tasks:openTasks().slice(0,16).map(t=>({name:txt(t.name,120),due:t.due||'',priority:t.priority||'normal'}))}}
async function fetchAI(){const controller=new AbortController();const timer=setTimeout(()=>controller.abort(),30000);try{const response=await fetch(settings.endpoint,{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json',...(settings.token?{'Authorization':'Bearer '+settings.token}:{})},body:JSON.stringify({messages:messages.slice(-14).map(x=>({role:x.role,content:x.content})),context:aiContext()}),signal:controller.signal,cache:'no-store'});let obj;try{obj=await response.json()}catch{throw Error('AIサーバーの返答がJSONではありません')};if(!response.ok)throw Error((obj.error||'サーバーエラー')+' ('+response.status+')');const answer=txt(obj.reply,3500);if(!answer)throw Error('AIから空の回答が返りました');return answer;}finally{clearTimeout(timer)}}
function syncState(){const online=!!settings.endpoint;$('#aiStatus').textContent=online?'AI接続設定あり':'ローカル会話';$('#aiStatus').classList.toggle('online',online);$('#aiModeInfo').textContent=online?'AI接続設定':'ローカル';$('#voiceBtn').classList.toggle('on',settings.voice);$('#voiceBtn').textContent=settings.voice?'🔊':'🔇';$('#voiceBtn').title=settings.voice?'読み上げON':'読み上げOFF'}
async function submitMessage(s){const q=txt(s,900);if(!q||requestBusy)return;$('#input').value='';stopSpeech();addMessage('user',q);setMood(moodFrom(q));requestBusy=true;$('#sendBtn').disabled=true;setStatus(settings.endpoint?'AI応答を取得中':'返答を準備中');let a='';try{if(settings.endpoint){a=await fetchAI()}else{a=offlineReply(q)}addMessage('assistant',a);if(settings.voice)speak(a)}catch(e){const fail='AIへの接続に失敗しました '+(e.name==='AbortError'?'30秒で時間切れ':txt(e.message,200))+'　設定を確認してください';addMessage('assistant',fail);announce('AI接続エラー');}finally{requestBusy=false;$('#sendBtn').disabled=false;if(!speechActive)setStatus('待機中・表情自動')}}
function stopSpeech(){
 if('speechSynthesis' in window){try{speechSynthesis.cancel()}catch{}}
 speechActive=false;synthesisUtterance=null;clearInterval(lipTimer);
 motion.lipTarget=0;motion.spreadTarget=0;motion.roundTarget=0;motion.mouthTrack=[];motion.syllables=[];setStatus('待機中・表情自動')
}
function speak(text){
 const s=txt(text,1100);
 if(!s||!('speechSynthesis' in window)){announce('読み上げ非対応');return}
 stopSpeech();const u=new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(s);synthesisUtterance=u;
 u.lang='ja-JP';u.rate=.96;u.pitch=1.02;
 const voices=speechSynthesis.getVoices();u.voice=voices.find(v=>v.lang.toLowerCase()==='ja-jp')||voices.find(v=>v.lang.toLowerCase().startsWith('ja'))||null;
 u.onstart=()=>{if(synthesisUtterance!==u)return;speechActive=true;startMouthTrack(s);setStatus('セレナが話しています')};
 u.onboundary=e=>{if(synthesisUtterance!==u)return;if(typeof e.charIndex==='number'){ /* browser charIndex counts UTF-16 units, while the mouth track counts characters */ const unicodeIndex=Array.from(s.slice(0,e.charIndex)).length;mouthBoundary(unicodeIndex);}};
 u.onend=()=>{if(synthesisUtterance===u)stopSpeech()};
 u.onerror=e=>{if(synthesisUtterance===u){stopSpeech();if(!['canceled','interrupted'].includes(e.error))announce('音声読み上げ失敗 '+(e.error||''))}};
 try{speechSynthesis.speak(u)}catch(e){announce('音声再生できません '+e.message)}
}
async function startRecordingFallback(){
 if(!settings.endpoint){announce('この環境では音声認識不可 iPhoneキーボードのマイクを使ってください');$('#input').focus();return}
 if(!navigator.mediaDevices?.getUserMedia||!window.MediaRecorder){announce('録音API非対応です キーボード音声入力を使ってください');$('#input').focus();return}
 if(!window.isSecureContext){announce('録音にはHTTPSが必要です');return}
 try{
   mediaStream=await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({audio:true});
   const mime=['audio/mp4','audio/webm;codecs=opus','audio/webm'].find(x=>MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported(x))||'';
   mediaRecorder=new MediaRecorder(mediaStream,mime?{mimeType:mime}:undefined);
   const chunks=[];
   mediaRecorder.ondataavailable=e=>{if(e.data&&e.data.size)chunks.push(e.data)};
   mediaRecorder.onstop=async()=>{
     clearTimeout(recorderTimer);mediaStream?.getTracks().forEach(t=>t.stop());mediaStream=null;
     $('#micBtn').classList.remove('recording');recognizing=false;
     if(!chunks.length){announce('音声が記録されませんでした');setStatus('待機中・表情自動');return}
     if(chunks.reduce((a,c)=>a+c.size,0)>6000000){announce('録音が大きすぎます');setStatus('待機中・表情自動');return}
     setStatus('音声を文字に変換中');
     try{
       const blob=new Blob(chunks,{type:mime||'audio/mp4'});
       const form=new FormData();form.append('file',blob,(mime.includes('webm')?'voice.webm':'voice.m4a'));
       const endpoint=settings.endpoint.replace(/\/$/,'')+'/transcribe';
       const response=await fetch(endpoint,{method:'POST',headers:{...(settings.token?{'Authorization':'Bearer '+settings.token}:{})},body:form});
       const out=await response.json();if(!response.ok||!out.text)throw Error(out.error||'文字起こしに失敗');
       $('#input').value=txt(out.text,900);await submitMessage(out.text);
     }catch(e){announce('文字起こし失敗 '+txt(e.message,80));setStatus('待機中・表情自動')}
   };
   mediaRecorder.onerror=()=>{announce('録音中にエラーが発生');stopRecordingFallback()};
   mediaRecorder.start();recognizing=true;$('#micBtn').classList.add('recording');setStatus('録音中 もう一度押すと送信');announce('録音開始 もう一度押すと送信します');
   recorderTimer=setTimeout(()=>stopRecordingFallback(),15000);
 }catch(e){mediaStream?.getTracks().forEach(t=>t.stop());mediaStream=null;announce('マイクが利用できません '+txt(e.message,70))}
}
function stopRecordingFallback(){if(mediaRecorder&&mediaRecorder.state==='recording'){mediaRecorder.stop();setStatus('音声処理中')} }
function startMic(){const Engine=window.SpeechRecognition||window.webkitSpeechRecognition;if(recognizing){if(mediaRecorder&&mediaRecorder.state==='recording')stopRecordingFallback();else try{recognition?.stop()}catch{}return}if(!Engine){startRecordingFallback();return}if(!window.isSecureContext){announce('音声認識にはHTTPSまたはlocalhostが必要です');return}try{stopSpeech();let r=new Engine();recognition=r;r.lang='ja-JP';r.interimResults=false;r.continuous=false;r.maxAlternatives=1;r.onstart=()=>{recognizing=true;$('#micBtn').classList.add('recording');$('#micBtn').setAttribute('aria-label','音声認識を停止');setStatus('聞いています…');announce('話しかけてください')};r.onresult=e=>{let text=Array.from(e.results).map(x=>x[0]&&x[0].transcript||'').join('').trim();if(text){$('#input').value=text;submitMessage(text)}else announce('認識できませんでした')};r.onerror=e=>{announce('音声認識エラー '+(e.error||'不明')+'　入力欄をタップしてキーボードのマイクでも入力できます');$('#input').focus()};r.onend=()=>{recognizing=false;$('#micBtn').classList.remove('recording');$('#micBtn').setAttribute('aria-label','音声入力を開始');if(!speechActive)setStatus('待機中・表情自動')};r.start()}catch(e){announce('マイクが使えません '+e.message)}}

// Same-origin AI backend discovery. A standalone HTML never claims AI is connected.
async function detectAIService(){
 if(!/^https?:$/.test(location.protocol))return;
 if(settings.endpoint)return;
 try{
  const c=new AbortController(),timer=setTimeout(()=>c.abort(),1800);
  let r;try{r=await fetch('./api/status',{signal:c.signal,cache:'no-store'});}finally{clearTimeout(timer)}
  if(!r.ok)return;
  const v=await r.json();
  if(v&&v.configured&&v.provider){
    settings.endpoint=new URL('./api/chat',location.href).href;
    syncState();renderSettings();announce('AIサーバーを検出しました');
  }else if(v&&v.provider){
    setStatus('AI未接続・定型応答モード');
  }
 }catch(e){ /* static hosting: offline demo mode remains usable */ }
}
